title: Tactical plan to stand down the covert organization
summary: Steven Greer tells of Tactical plan to stand down the covert organization, about 2023-2025 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Oh. Oh, yes. It's already been in place for about a year and a half, two years have been.

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who has long campaigned for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that a plan already exists to shut down the secret group he says controls UFO secrets. He says it had been in place for about a year and a half to two years, putting it around 2023 to 2025. If true, it would mean that someone was actively working to take that hidden group apart.
